summary: RG-4 Plugin Plan-driven generation and test mode: make confirmed Plan the hard precondition for cold-start/deep-mining/module-mining, route all three generation stages through the shared Core Plan intent + read-time projection, and add scoped testMode generation without full cold-start.

targetTasks.summary: Current window: AlembicPlugin. Claim only task rg4-plugin-plan-driven-generation-test-mode-t1 under stateRoot .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-evolution-optimization-2026-06-21. Context: RG-1/RG-2 Core planning signals are accepted; RG-3 Core Plan ledger/projection is accepted at AlembicCore commit dd4db2c59cea3cf8c3363b4927683c9cccd45a87; RG-3 Plugin alembic_plan draft/confirm/get is accepted at AlembicPlugin commit 5698d0f31dc3e1dc170d01a2400e9ac96d436a73. Goal: implement RG-4 Plugin Plan-driven generation/test mode as real connected behavior, not a shell. Required behavior: (1) enforce confirmed Plan as the hard precondition for cold-start/bootstrap, deep-mining/rescan, and module-mining/scoped generation. When no active confirmed Plan exists or projectContextSignature is stale, return a visible gate block modeled on buildBootstrapRebuildConfirmationBlock style: success false or equivalent, needsUserInput/blocked reason, nextActions pointing to alembic_plan draft then confirm, and no destructive fullReset or generation side effect. (2) Make the three generation stages consume the same Core Plan intent plus Core read-time generation-state projection: coldStart uses Plan selected dimensions/order/scale/stage targets; deepMining/rescan uses Plan deepMining targets and existing coverage/gaps; moduleMining/scoped generation uses Plan moduleBindings/moduleScope and coverage gaps. Generation results must write existing DB/source-ref/knowledge/proposal/lifecycle records so Plan state changes appear through projection; do not double-write generation-state into Plan intent or create a Plugin-only Plan store. (3) Add or wire module-mining/scoped generation as a first-class stage using existing ProjectContext scoped/module analysis, audit/evidence gate, submissionTracker/session patterns, cleanupPolicy:'none', and no knowledge deletion. (4) Add testMode support for scoped validation runs after a confirmed Plan, with inputs equivalent to { testMode:true, dimensions:[subset], scaleOverride:{small budgets}, moduleScope?:[...] }. Test mode must require confirmed Plan, must not run full cold-start/fullReset, must preserve grounding/no-guess behavior, and must be able to produce a small scoped Recipe path suitable for later BiliDili RG-10 verification. (5) Extend rescan/module-mining concurrency safety with the same lease/idempotency spirit as BootstrapSession: rescanId/epoch or equivalent idempotent run key, no duplicate destructive cleanup, and clear in-progress/blocked diagnostics. (6) Keep existing four public MCP tool semantics intact except for the intentional Plan hard gate on generation entrypoints; update tool output contracts and clean-output projections where needed. Boundaries: do not implement RG-5 create-time ProjectContext anchor/nextActions grounding UX beyond what RG-4 generation already needs; do not implement RG-6 vector isAvailable isolation, RG-7 create/evolve immediate vector/source-ref timing repair, RG-8 commit-driven unified evolution/rename/new-module git routing, RG-9 cleanup, RG-10 BiliDili real scenario, daemon/watch behavior, or deletion of evidence/proposal/vector structures. Do not create a type-only shell, static mock, active-plan.json side store, or language-only planner. If the full RG-4 slice proves too large for one target turn, return blocked/needs-review with the smallest coherent executable split and raw evidence; otherwise complete with commit hash, changed files, evidence refs, validation output, risks, and next-step notes. Expected validation: npm run build:check; targeted tests proving no Plan blocks bootstrap/rescan/module-mining before side effects; confirmed Plan drives cold-start/rescan/module-mining dimensions/budgets/module scope; testMode runs scoped/no-fullReset/no-cleanup path; rescan/module-mining lease/idempotency behavior; existing bootstrap/rescan/dimension-completion/MCP output contract tests touched by the change; repo/core/layer boundary lints; biome/lint when feasible; git diff --check. Full unit suite may remain red only if failures are proven outside touched scope.
